trust_decision.summary: Whether a local MCP server container is placed on an isolated internal network behind the egress proxy (which blocks host.docker.internal/gateway addresses) is decided by RunConfig.IsolateNetwork in the Docker deploy path; that flag defaults to false unless each front end sets it.

landing_point.why: Summary says containers reach host services; the --isolate-network flag (default false) sits next to --allow-docker-gateway whose help text names host.docker.internal.

fix_sites.entry_point: HTTP API create/update workload (request JSON field network_isolation)
HTTP API create/update workload (new networkIsolationEnabled nil->true helper in pkg/api/v1/workload_types.go)
HTTP API CreateWorkloadFromRequest / UpdateWorkloadFromRequest via BuildFullRunConfig (pkg/api/v1/workload_service.go:96-134)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: pkg/api/v1/workload_types.go:75 (bool field: omitted JSON field decodes to false; fix makes it *bool with nil->true, fix.diff:128-146)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The TUI and the `run_server` MCP tool are experimental/convenience front ends that expose only a subset of options (pkg/tui/actions.go:143-146 says so), and the advisory/fix frame the default as a `thv run`/API flag, so a solver can argue they inherit 'whatever the builder does' and are out of scope.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Explicit opt-out must keep working (--isolate-network=false, API network_isolation:false), and upgrade must preserve an existing workload's stored setting rather than force isolation on; also permission-profile custom network modes (host/none) bypass the isolated network by design.

O6_input_shapes: API JSON field omitted (nil) vs explicit false vs explicit true
API GET response round-trip (runConfigToCreateRequest pointer to stored value)

O7_producer.where: pkg/api/v1/workload_types.go:75 (request schema decides the omitted-field default); also pkg/runner/config.go:189 (RunConfig isolate_network,omitempty read by ReadJSON at pkg/runner/config.go:344)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: MCP tool `run_server` (thv mcp serve / thv serve --experimental-mcp) builds a RunConfig without WithNetworkIsolation, so it stays at the builder's false default after the fix.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Agent-facing experimental MCP control server with a minimal arg set (server,name,host,env,secrets); not mentioned in the advisory.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: pkg/mcp/server vs cmd/thv/app; reached from cmd/thv/app/mcp_serve.go:32-65 and cmd/thv/app/server.go:136-142

O8_uncovered_routes.route: TUI 'run from registry' builds a RunConfig without WithNetworkIsolation, so it stays non-isolated after the fix.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Comment says it mirrors BuildRunnerConfig 'only for the subset of options relevant to a TUI flow' (pkg/tui/actions.go:143-146); UI path, not CLI/API.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: `thv run --from-config` deserializes RunConfig where isolate_network is omitempty, so a config file that omits the field runs non-isolated.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: A config file is an explicit full specification (normally from `thv export`); changing deserialization defaults would alter stored state of existing workloads loaded via LoadState.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: pkg/runner serializer, separate from flag definition

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Builder initial RunConfig leaves IsolateNetwork false; a planted second builder/defaulting helper (e.g. a registry-run convenience builder) that omits isolation.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Every front end constructs options independently; a maintainer adding a new front end copies a subset of options as the TUI did.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Add an `isolate_network` arg to the MCP tool args bound as a plain bool (omitted -> false) mirroring the pre-fix API bug.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Same shape as the API updateRequest bool field the fix had to convert to *bool.

O10_build.project_tests: pkg/api/v1/workloads_types_test.go (TestRunConfigToCreateRequest), pkg/runner config builder tests, e2e under test/e2e needs Docker

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Flip the --isolate-network CLI default to true and stop, leaving the API bool (omitted->false), TUI and MCP run_server tool non-isolated; or force isolation in the builder/deployer, breaking explicit opt-out and upgrade preservation.

out_of_scope_notes: Permission profile network_mode host/none skips the isolated network entirely (pkg/container/docker/client.go:1571-1576); by design, not pursued.
Kubernetes operator path uses NewOperatorRunConfigBuilder (pkg/runner/config_builder.go:926-933); Docker-network isolation not applicable there, not pursued.
